citations.assessment: The named Botzraya occurs at 25:2 of the checked Krakow edition in the exposition on Uriah. Chapter 26 contains a distinct plain Rabbi Yonah transmission. Preserve the received chapter number.
The name Rabbi Yonah Botzray appears alongside the other sages in the contrast of scriptural uses of zeh.
Botzraya explains the roasting of the paschal lamb as in accordance with its law.
